legalConnect: This app connects to a server its owner runs. What's on that server is theirs, not the WittyMediaServer project's: the project, its contributors and affiliates don't provide, host, endorse or check it.
findSearching: Looking for servers on your network…
findNone: No servers found on your network yet.
findNotSupported: This device can't search your network. Enter your server's address instead.
addressHint: It looks like 192.168.1.20 or https://media.example.com. WittyMediaServer shows it when it starts.
errScheme: That isn't a web address. Use something like 192.168.1.20.
errCredentials: Leave out the name and password. You'll sign in on the next screen.
errInvalid: That doesn't look like an address. It should look like 192.168.1.20.
errPublicHttp: That address is on the internet, and your password would travel unencrypted. Use an https:// address instead.
errUnreachable: Can't reach a server there. Check the address, and that WittyMediaServer is running and this device is on the same network.
errNotServer: Something answered at that address, but it isn't WittyMediaServer.
errLost: Lost contact with your server. Check that it is running, then try again.
errNotSetUp: That server hasn't been set up yet. Open its address in a web browser to finish setting it up.
errServerOld: That server is too old for this app. Update WittyMediaServer, then try again.
errAppOld: This server needs a newer version of this app.
errCertificate: That server's security certificate can't be trusted, so nothing was sent to it.
pairHint: On a phone or computer already signed in, open this address and type the code:
pairScan: Or scan this with your phone:
notKept: This device couldn't keep your sign-in safely, so you'll be asked to sign in again next time.
showCodeInstead: Show a code on this screen instead
codeHint: On a phone or computer signed in to this server, open Sign in a TV (under You, or under your name in the corner on the web) and get a code there.
identityTitle: This isn't the server you used before
identityHint: A different machine is answering at this address. It could be your server after a reinstall, or a look-alike. Only trust it if you know why it changed.
identityTrust: This is my server, trust it
identityBad: This server couldn't prove who it is, so nothing was sent to it.
identityChanged: This server's identity changed while you were on this screen, so nothing was sent to it. Check the new fingerprint before carrying on.
findSubtitle: Pick your WittyMediaServer, or enter its address.
twoFactorTitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactorHint: Your account asks for a second step. Open your authenticator app and type the six digits it shows for this server.
openOnPhone: Open this on a phone or computer:
errWrongPassword: That password isn't right. Try again.
errWrongNameOrPassword: That name or password isn't right. Try again.
errWrongCode: That code isn't right. Use the newest one your authenticator app shows.
useAuthenticatorCode: Use the code from your app
recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Type one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on the second step. Each one works once.
errWrongRecovery: That recovery code isn't right, or it has been used already.
gamesNoneDetail: This server has no games library. An owner adds one in Settings on the server's website.
liveTvNoneDetail: This server has no TV channels. An owner sets them up in Settings on the server's website.
librariesNoneDetail: An owner adds them in Settings on the server's website.
profileNameHint: What everyone sees on this server's profiles. Leave it empty to use your username.
usernameHint: What you type to sign in.
usernameKidsHint: Only an adult can change this profile's names.
showUsernameHint: Next to your picture in the server's own pages, in place of your profile name.
errUsernameEmpty: Type a username. It's what you sign in with.
passwordChangeHint: At least 8 characters. Your other devices will be signed out.
errPasswordsDiffer: The two new passwords aren't the same.
twoStepIntro: Ask for a code from an authenticator app as well as your password, so a password on its own can't get in.
twoStepUnavailable: This server can't offer two-step sign-in yet.
twoStepScanTitle: Add this server to your authenticator app
twoStepScanHint: Scan the code with the app, or type the key. Then enter the six digits it shows.
twoStepOpenApp: Open in an authenticator app on this phone
twoStepSavedHint: If you lose your phone, each of these signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: this is the only time they're shown.
twoStepTurnOffHint: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app.
devicesHint: Everywhere you're signed in. Sign out of anything you don't recognise.
signOutOthersConfirm: Sign out everywhere except this device?
signInTvHint: Type the code your TV shows.
signInTvDone: The TV is signing in now.
signInTvInvite: The TV asks for a code?
signInTvInviteHint: Type this on the TV. It works once, for {minutes} minutes.
signInTvAdultOnly: An adult profile has to do this.
themeHint: Only on this device. The server's own pages in the app follow it too.
topMenuHint: Only on this TV. Libraries you tick here go in the menu along the top, after Search.
themeAutomaticHint: Light or dark, as this device is set
pairBusy: This server has given this device a lot of codes lately. Wait a few minutes for a new one, or sign in with a password now.
themeWebOnly: Some themes add pictures and effects that only the website can show; their colours still come across.
wpMultiplayerLater: Play with someone on another server. Coming later.
